places.name: Île aux Cerfs Island (Lagoon Paradise)
places.ai_summary: A tropical paradise with white sandy beaches, turquoise lagoons, and a variety of water sports activities.

opening_hours.notes: Boat transfers available from Trou d’Eau Douce.

places.place_tip: Book a catamaran tour for the best experience.

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:Coat of arms of Mauritius (Original version).svg

attribution.title: Coat of arms of Mauritius (Original version)
attribution.author: Yashveer Poonit
attribution.credit: This vector image includes elements that have been taken or adapted from this file:
attribution.description:
The armorial ensigns and supporters of Mauritius are described as:
(a) for arms-

Quarterly azure and or.
In the first quarter a lymphad or.
In the second, 3 palm trees vert.
In the third, a key in pale the wards downwards gules.
In the issuant, from the base a pile, and in chief a mullet argent.
(b) for the supporters-

On the dexter side, a dodo per bend sinister embattled gules and argent, and
On the sinister side, a sambur deer per bend embattled argent and gules, each supporting a sugar cane erect proper,
(c) with the motto "Stella Clavisque Maris Indici” (Latin: Star and Key of the Indian Ocean)

places.name: Trou d’Eau Douce Village
places.ai_summary: A charming fishing village known for its tranquil atmosphere, local markets, and as a gateway to Île aux Cerfs.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored in the morning.

places.place_tip: Visit the local market for fresh seafood and crafts.

places.name: Belle Mare Beach
places.ai_summary: A pristine beach with calm waters, ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying a peaceful day by the sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Bring sunscreen and a beach umbrella for shade.

places.name: Palmar Beach
places.ai_summary: A serene beach known for its soft sand and clear waters, perfect for a relaxing day or a romantic sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Sunset views are best from the beach.

places.place_tip: Stay for the sunset, it's breathtaking.

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:1780 Raynal and Bonne Map of Mascarene Islands, Reunion, Mauritius, Bourbon - Geographicus - GeneralesIsles-bonne-1780.jpg

attribution.title: Carte générale des isles
attribution.author: Rigobert Bonne
attribution.credit: This file was provided to Wikimedia Commons by Geographicus Rare Antique Maps, a specialist dealer in rare maps and other cartography of the 15th, 16th, 17th, 18th and 19th centuries, as part of a cooperation project.
attribution.description: A fine example of Rigobert Bonne and Guilleme Raynal’s 1780 map of the Réunion (Ile Bourbon), Mauritius (Ile de France), and Rodrigues Islands, collectively known as the Mascarene Islands.  Essentially four maps in one, the first map shows Réunion (Bourbon) Island.  This map includes inland mountain ranges, featuring an erupting volcano in profile, and a detailed coastline with cities, rivers and ports.  The center-most map details Mauritius Island (Ile de France).  Shows major cities and rivers and a detailed coast-line, including reefs, shoals, and other underwater dangers.  The third map focuses on Rodrigues Island (Rodrigue Island).  Features mountain ranges, cities, and the barrier reef surrounding the island. Drawn by R. Bonne for G. Raynal’s   Atlas de toutes les parties connues du globe terrestre, dressé pour l'histoire  philosophique et politique des établissemens et du commerce des Européens dans les deux Indes .

places.name: Flacq Market (Largest Outdoor Market)
places.ai_summary: The largest outdoor market in Mauritius, offering a wide variety of local products, crafts, and street food.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Try the street food and buy local handicrafts.

places.name: Grand River South East Waterfall
places.ai_summary: A beautiful waterfall located at the mouth of the Grand River, accessible by a short hike or boat trip.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning. Bring water and snacks.

places.place_tip: Combine with a boat trip for a full experience.

places.name: Diving at Blue Bay Marine Park
places.ai_summary: Experience stunning coral reefs and diverse marine life at this popular diving spot.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking for diving trips is recommended.

places.place_tip: Bring your own diving gear or rent at the site.

places.name: Boat Trip to Lighthouse Island
places.ai_summary: A scenic boat trip to the uninhabited Lighthouse Island, known for its bird sanctuary and historic lighthouse.

opening_hours.notes: Check boat schedules in advance.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for bird watching.

places.name: Poste Lafayette Beach
places.ai_summary: A quiet beach with golden sand and clear waters, ideal for a peaceful retreat.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Bring your own snacks and drinks.

places.name: Anahita Golf Course
places.ai_summary: A premier golf course set in a stunning location, offering a challenging game for golf enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking for tee times is recommended.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the views of the lagoon from the course.

places.name: Ile aux Aigrettes Nature Reserve
places.ai_summary: A nature reserve protecting a fragile ecosystem with rare plants and animals, offering guided tours.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Guided tours only.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour in advance.

places.name: Blue Bay Snorkeling Trail
places.ai_summary: A popular snorkeling spot with a rich variety of marine life and coral reefs, suitable for all levels.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Bring your own snorkeling gear or rent at the site.

places.name: La Cambuse Beach (Hidden Gem)
places.ai_summary: A secluded beach known for its natural beauty, clear waters, and tranquility, perfect for a quiet day out.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Take your trash with you to keep the beach clean.

places.name: Bois des Amourettes Jetty
places.ai_summary: A picturesque jetty offering stunning views of the lagoon and a great spot for fishing and photography.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and fishing gear.

places.name: Vieux Grand Port Ruins (Oldest Settlement)
places.ai_summary: The ruins of the oldest settlement in Mauritius, offering a glimpse into the island's colonial past.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Mahebourg Museum.

places.name: Mahebourg Waterfront
places.ai_summary: A scenic waterfront area in Mahebourg, perfect for a leisurely stroll, with views of the harbor and the island of Île aux Serpents.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the local shops and cafes nearby.

places.name: National History Museum (Naval Museum)
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the naval history of Mauritius, with exhibits on shipbuilding, navigation, and maritime artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry at 16:30.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Mahebourg Market.

places.name: Frederik Hendrik Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the history of the Dutch settlement in Mauritius, with artifacts and exhibits from the 17th century.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry at 16:30.

places.place_tip: Check out the replica of the Dutch ship, the Zeeman.

places.name: Pont Naturel Cliff Arches
places.ai_summary: Natural rock formations in the shape of arches, offering a stunning viewpoint and photo opportunity.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for the rocky terrain.

places.name: Sunset Catamaran Cruise
places.ai_summary: A relaxing cruise on a catamaran boat, enjoying the beautiful sunset over the Indian Ocean.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is highly recommended.

places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket, it can get windy on the water.
